profile.headline: Entrepreneur and Student of Aero/Astro Engineering @ Purdue University
profile.summary: Bright-eyed and full of spirit! I'm incredibly passionate about the crossroads between entrepreneurship and engineering, ready to take on the big tasks that will change the world. From wildfire drone systems to global water access, I aim to work with purpose and use my skills to elevate those around me. Always on the lookout for bold new ideas, grounded partnerships, and good people to build with!

positions.title: EWB Purdue Chapter - International Project Engineer and Officer of Ethical Development
positions.locationName: West Lafayette, Indiana, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Currently a student engineer on our chapter's Rwandan water project, in which we are designing water purification and transportation systems allowing thousands of community members access to clean water. 
Previously served in an officer position which focused heavily on monitoring the ethical and cultural consequences of foreign development projects and real-world engineering decision making processes.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) · AutoCAD · Teamwork · Construction Drawings · Hydraulic Calculations · Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) · Hydraulic Systems · Civil Engineering · International Cooperation · Interdisciplinary Design · Professional Ethics · Community Development

positions.title: Undergraduate Data Science Researcher
positions.locationName: West Lafayette, Indiana, United States · On-site
positions.description: Worked with a team of around 15 students in a corporate partnership with BARRIOS to develop a VR visualization tool for NASA to render Gateway in various configurations and orbits. This tool was meant to assist NASA in their increasingly important visualization efforts which streamline mission planning, astronaut training, and engineering design processes. After presenting to NASA and receiving very positive feedback, we submitted a paper titled "Foundations of a Visualization Tool for NASA Gateway and Lunar Surface Operations" and presented it at the IEEE International Conference on Space Mission Challenges for Information Technology / Space Computing Conference (SMC-IT/SCC 2025)
positions.insights: Skills: Unreal Engine 5 · GitHub · Virtual Reality (VR) · Software Development · Software Project Management · Software Documentation · Computer-Aided Design (CAD) · Modeling and Simulation · Blender · Presentation Skills · Scientific Papers

positions.title: President and Head of Research
positions.locationName: West Lafayette, Indiana, United States · On-site
positions.description: The Space & Earth Analogs Research Chapter of Purdue (SEARCH) is a student organization aiming to increase support and capacity for human space exploration. To support this mission statement, SEARCH has several individual and unique departments each focusing on different areas. We have one of the worlds only Student Analog Astronaut Training Programs (SA2TP). We also have an engineering design team that is developing a one-of-a-kind analog research facility for Bio-regenerative Life Support Systems and Bioastronautics, a research team and a software team doing work with/for NASA, and an outreach and business team to bring people and opportunities into the organization.
positions.insights: Skills: Engineering Design · Computer-Aided Design (CAD) · Leadership · Design Research · Team Leadership · Revit · Project Coordination · Teamwork · 3D Modeling · Interdisciplinary Research · SOLIDWORKS · Public Speaking · Project Management · Networking · Corporate Fundraising · Project Planning · Recruiting · Interdisciplinary Collaboration · Interdisciplinary Design · Organizational Leadership · Collaborative Leadership

projects.title: Project FIREFLY
projects.description: An entrepreneurial venture aiming to develop a novel sensor package and data algorithms for long endurance glider's to provide firefighters truly real time wildfire monitoring data. With this type of data, firefighters will be able to better calculate the best strategies for fighting wildfires and improve their safety while doing so.

projects.title: EWB: Rwandan Water Project
projects.description: These projects are done through the Engineers Without Borders Purdue Chapter, in which we are collaborating with Rwandan Engineers to build water treatment and transportation systems for several communities facing water related crises. I got to travel in May of 2025 to Rwanda to see the various sites in person, perform necessary field work, conduct design revisions based on said field work, and monitor implementation and project success of our various systems. I also got to work with the communities and connect on a personal level to the wonderful culture and people of Rwanda!
